reuse.why: Puts the guard in the existing shared linkBankSyncAccount that every provider-specific link function delegates to, though it issues its own account lookup instead of hoisting the accRow fetch that the function already does for upgradingId.

duplication.why: No copied logic; the only redundancy is reading the same accounts row twice (closed check, then SELECT * for the update).

placement.why: The check sits at the top of the shared link routine, before the duplicate-link check and any write, which is where the tree validates link requests.

scope.why: Only the guard and three targeted tests.

maintainability.why: Simple and covers all providers; merging the two lookups of the upgrading account would be slightly cleaner.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses linkBankSyncAccount, the single entry all link providers share.

one_place.where: linkBankSyncAccount in server/accounts/app.ts, used by the GoCardless, SimpleFin, Pluggy, Akahu, Enable Banking and Fintegra link handlers.
